purpose: BFS website-to-Markdown crawler with trafilatura extraction, atomic resume state, and a hardened local HTTP API (127.0.0.1:8765) for the Chrome extension
Side-panel client: captures active-tab DOM, POSTs /save or /crawl to localhost:8765, polls /list for stats and saved URLs
MV3 manifest: sidePanel, activeTab, scripting permissions; background service worker
Self-contained harness: unit checks on security/pure helpers plus a functional two-page localhost crawl and a crash-path regression
Optional pre-provisioning of trafilatura/lxml into a chosen interpreter
Claude-skill packaging of the tool; frontmatter triggers plus usage that must mirror the real CLI flags
